Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (December 12, 2019) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Tender Call No. 199-2019; Contract No. 19ECS-MI-02SW Description: Construction services for Keele Valley landfill gas flare system upgrades.
